description: How far plasma CL moves as each input is varied over a range, e.g. a predicted fu,p over its 50% range.

inputSchema.description: The same inputs as a calculation, plus the range to vary each over.

assay_type.description: Assay type for CLint scaling. microsomes: uses MPPGL (mg/g) × 1e-3; hepatocytes: uses HPGL (×10⁶ cells/g) × 1e-3.
assay_type.title: Assay Type

clint.description: Intrinsic clearance (µL/min/mg microsomal protein). Use ge=0: zero clearance is physiologically valid.
clint.title: Clint

clint_censored.description: Set when the assay reported CLint below its limit of quantification and `clint` is that limit rather than a measurement. CLint then lies in [0, clint), so every clearance output is an upper bound: `upper_bound` is true, no observed-CL band is returned, and the clint_below_loq flag fires.
clint_censored.title: Clint Censored

correction_id.description: Saved lab correction (/api/correction-equations) to apply. Must match species and assay_type. Corrects predicted plasma CL and replaces the reference band with one from the lab's compounds.
correction_id.title: Correction Id

fu_mic.description: Unbound fraction in microsomes (0–1). Corrects for non-specific microsomal binding.
fu_mic.title: Fu Mic

fu_p.description: Unbound fraction in plasma (0–1). Plasma protein binding correction.
fu_p.title: Fu P

fu_p_range.description: A predicted fu,p carries its 50% range; pass it to see what it costs.

model.description: IVIVE model. well-stirred (venous equilibrium) or parallel-tube (sinusoidal perfusion).
model.title: Model

rb.description: Blood-to-plasma concentration ratio. fu_b = fu_p / Rb. Output is blood clearance.
rb.title: Rb

species.description: Species for physiological parameters (Qh, MPPGL, liver weight).
species.title: Species

inputSchema.title: SensitivityRequest

name: input_sensitivity
